Functions

The 314 functions computed by DocCells, by field, with an example of each.

  • To search: typing a function's name in the field at the top of the page (/) leads to its row.
  • Arguments are separated by commas; arguments between square brackets [ ] are optional.
  • TRUE() and FALSE() are written with their parentheses; 1 and 0 can also be written.
  • A “range” argument can be a list: =AVERAGE([12, 15, 8]).
  • See also Formulas: operators, references, errors.

Mathematics

FunctionDescription and example
SUM(value1, [value2, …])Sum of a series of numbers and/or cells.=SUM(A1:A5) → 62
SUMIF(range, criterion, [sum_range])Sum of the cells of a range that meet a criterion (">=10", "Ana"), or of the matching cells of sum_range.=SUMIF(A1:A5, ">=10") → 54
SUMIFS(sum_range, criteria_range1, criterion1, [criteria_range2, …])Sums a range depending on multiple criteria.=SUMIFS(A1:A5, A1:A5, ">9", B1:B5, "<8") → 27
SUMPRODUCT(array1, [array2, …])Sum of products of elements in two arrays.=SUMPRODUCT(A1:A5, B1:B5) → 378
SUMSQ(value1, [value2, …])Sum of squares.=SUMSQ(B1:B3) → 56
SUMX2MY2(array_x, array_y)Sum of the differences of squares.=SUMX2MY2(A1:A5, B1:B5) → 581
SUMX2PY2(array_x, array_y)Sum of the sums of squares.=SUMX2PY2(A1:A5, B1:B5) → 1063
SUMXMY2(array_x, array_y)Sum of the squares of differences.=SUMXMY2(A1:A5, B1:B5) → 307
SERIESSUM(x, n, m, a)Sum of a power series.=SERIESSUM(2, 0, 1, [1, 1, 1]) → 7
SUBTOTAL(function_code, range1, [range2, …])Summary of a range by a code: 1 average, 2 count, 4 max, 5 min, 9 sum.=SUBTOTAL(9, A1:A5) → 62
AGGREGATE(function, option, range)Summary of a range by a code: 1 average, 2 count, 4 max, 5 min, 9 sum. Options: 0 to 7, as in Excel.=AGGREGATE(9, 0, A1:A5) → 62
PRODUCT(factor1, [factor2, …])Result of multiplying a series of numbers together.=PRODUCT(B1:B3) → 48
COUNTUNIQUE(value1, [value2])Counts number of unique values in a range.=COUNTUNIQUE(A1:A5) → 5
ABS(value)Absolute value of a number.=ABS(-3) → 3

ISODD(value)Whether the provided value is odd.=ISODD(4) → FALSE

COMBIN(n, k)Number of combinations from a set of objects.=COMBIN(5, 2) → 10

Logic

FunctionDescription and example
IF(logical_expression, value_if_true, [value_if_false])Returns value depending on logical expression.=IF(A1>=10, "pass", "fail") → pass
IFS(condition1, value1, [condition2, value2, …])Value of the first true condition; #N/A if none is.=IFS(A1>=16, "very good", A1>=12, "good") → good
SWITCH(expression, case1, value1, [case2, value2, …], [default])Value of the case equal to the expression.=SWITCH(2, 1, "one", 2, "two", "other") → two
AND(logical_expression1, [logical_expression2, …])Logical `and` operator.=AND(A1>10, B1>1) → TRUE
OR(logical_expression1, logical_expression2)Logical `or` operator.=OR(A1>20, B1>1) → TRUE
XOR(value1, value2, …)True if an odd number of values are true.=XOR(TRUE(), FALSE()) → TRUE
NOT(logical_expression)Returns opposite of provided logical value.=NOT(TRUE()) → FALSE
TRUE()The logical value true, displayed as TRUE.=TRUE() → TRUE
FALSE()The logical value false, displayed as FALSE.=FALSE() → FALSE
IFERROR(value, value_if_error)The value, or another one if it is the error of a function (#N/A, #NUM!). Replaces neither DIV/0 nor #VALUE!.=IFERROR(NA(), "absent") → absent
IFNA(value, value_if_na)The value, or another one if it is the #N/A error.=IFNA(NA(), "absent") → absent

Lookup and lists

FunctionDescription and example
VLOOKUP(search_key, range, index, [is_sorted])Looks for a value in the first column of a range, returns the cell of the same row. Last argument 0: exact value.=VLOOKUP("Paul", C1:C5, 1, 0) → Paul
HLOOKUP(search_key, range, index, [is_sorted])Looks for a value in the first row of a range, returns the cell of the same column. Last argument 0: exact value.=HLOOKUP(1, F1:G2, 2, 0) → 3
LOOKUP(value, sorted_range, result_range)Looks for a value in a sorted range, returns the matching value of another range.=LOOKUP(6, B1:B5, A1:A5) → 8
MATCH(search_key, range, [search_type])Position of a value in a range. Last argument 0: exact value.=MATCH("Léa", C1:C5, 0) → 3
INDEX(reference, row, column)Cell of a range or element of a list, by its position.=INDEX(A1:A5, MATCH("Léa", C1:C5, 0)) → 8
CHOOSE(index, choice1, [choice2, …])An element from a list of choices based on index.=CHOOSE(2, "a", "b", "c") → b
ROW([cell_reference])Row number of a specified cell.=ROW(B7) → 7
COLUMN([cell_reference])Column number of a specified cell.=COLUMN(B7) → 2
ROWS(range)Number of rows in a specified array or range.=ROWS(A1:C5) → 5
COLUMNS(range)Number of columns in a specified array or range.=COLUMNS(A1:C5) → 3
TRANSPOSE(array_or_range)Swaps rows and columns; the result is a list of rows, in one cell.=TRANSPOSE(F1:G2) → [[1, 3], [2, 4]]
FLATTEN(range)The values of a range, row after row, as a list.=FLATTEN(F1:G2) → [1, 2, 3, 4]
UNIQUE(value1, value2, …)List of the values without duplicates.=UNIQUE(1, 2, 2) → [1, 2]

Text

FunctionDescription and example
CONCATENATE(string1, [string2, …])Appends strings to one another.=CONCATENATE("Mark: ", A1) → Mark: 12
CONCAT(value1, value2)Joins two texts.=CONCAT("a", "b") → ab
LEFT(string, number_of_characters)Substring from beginning of specified string.=LEFT("tables", 3) → tab
RIGHT(string, number_of_characters)A substring from the end of a specified string.=RIGHT("tables", 3) → les
MID(string, starting_at, extract_length)A segment of a string.=MID("tables", 2, 3) → abl
LEN(text)Length of a string.=LEN("tables") → 6
LOWER(text)Converts a specified string to lowercase.=LOWER("ABC") → abc
UPPER(text)Converts a specified string to uppercase.=UPPER("abc") → ABC
PROPER(text_to_capitalize)Capitalizes each word in a specified string.=PROPER("john smith") → John Smith
TRIM(text)Removes space characters.=TRIM(" a b ") → a b
CLEAN(text)Removes non-printable characters from a piece of text.=CLEAN("abc") → abc
FIND(search_for, text_to_search, [starting_at])First position of string found in text, case-sensitive.=FIND("b", "tables") → 3
SEARCH(search_for, text_to_search, starting_at)First position of string found in text, ignoring case.=SEARCH("B", "tables") → 3
REPLACE(text, position, length, new_text)Replaces part of a text string with different text.=REPLACE("tables", 1, 5, "X") → Xs
SUBSTITUTE(text_to_search, search_for, replace_with, occurrence_number)Replaces existing text with new text in a string.=SUBSTITUTE("a-b-c", "-", "+") → a+b+c
REPT(text_to_repeat, number_of_repetitions)Specified text repeated a number of times.=REPT("ab", 3) → ababab
EXACT(string1, string2)Tests whether two strings are identical.=EXACT("a", "A") → FALSE
SPLIT(text, separator)Cuts a text into a list.=SPLIT("a-b", "-") → [a, b]
VALUE(text)Number written in a text, with a decimal point.=VALUE("12") → 12
CHAR(table_number)Gets character associated with number.=CHAR(65) → A
CODE(string)Numeric unicode map value of character.=CODE("A") → 65
UNICHAR(code)Character of a Unicode code.=UNICHAR(960) → π
UNICODE(text)Unicode code of the first character.=UNICODE("π") → 960
REGEXMATCH(text, regular_expression)Whether a piece of text matches regular expression.=REGEXMATCH("abc", "b") → TRUE
REGEXEXTRACT(text, regular_expression)Extracts matching substrings with regular expression.=REGEXEXTRACT("ab12", "[0-9]+") → 12
REGEXREPLACE(text, regular_expression, replacement)Replaces text with regular expressions.=REGEXREPLACE("ab12", "[0-9]+", "x") → abx

Dates and times

FunctionDescription and example
TODAY()Today's date. To calculate with it, put it in a cell.=TODAY()
NOW()Date and time, recalculated at each change.=NOW()
DATE(year, month, day)Date of a year, a month and a day; give the cell a date format.=DATE(2026, 11, 25) → 46351
YEAR(date)Year specified by a given date.=YEAR(DATE(2026, 11, 25)) → 2026
MONTH(date)Month of the year a specific date falls in.=MONTH(DATE(2026, 11, 25)) → 11
DAY(date)Day of the month that a specific date falls on.=DAY(DATE(2026, 11, 25)) → 25
WEEKDAY(date, [type])Day of the week; with type 2, from 1 (Monday) to 7 (Sunday).=WEEKDAY(DATE(2026, 11, 25), 2) → 3

Functions not computed

The completion and the library of DocCells also name functions that are not computed: they give #NAME? or #ERROR!. The same goes for recent Excel functions.

Not computedInstead
TEXT, FIXED, DOLLARa number format in the cell
XLOOKUP, OFFSET, INDIRECT, ADDRESSINDEX and MATCH, VLOOKUP, CHOOSE
FILTER, SORT, SEQUENCE, LET, LAMBDAsort and filter; fill a formula
MAXIFS, MINIFS, TEXTJOINa filter; the & operator
MMULT, MDETERM, MINVERSESUMPRODUCT, one formula per element
HYPERLINKinsert a link
Excel names with a dot: RANK.EQ, VAR.S, NORM.DIST…the name without the dot or the old name: RANK, VAR, NORMDIST
database functions (DSUM…), coupons and securities (PRICE, COUPNUM…), ISBLANK, CELL, ISFORMULASUMIFS; =A1="" for an empty cell
